seo.title: Helping a Parent Sell Their Home
seo.description: Helping a parent sell their home? Agent Finder is built for family conversations — plain explanations, no pressure, and all the time you need to think it through together.

data.heading: Helping a parent sell
data.lead: Many of the people we help aren’t selling themselves — they’re adult children supporting a parent through a downsize, a move closer to family, or the next chapter of care. Agent Finder is designed for these conversations.
checks: Loop the whole family in — your advisor speaks with everyone, at a pace that suits.
Plain explanations of contracts, commission, marketing and timelines.
Time to think — no agent contact until your parent feels ready.
Support for the practical side too: stylists, conveyancers, moving services.

image.alt: Adult daughter sitting with her mother going through paperwork

testimonial.quote: “Mum felt heard the whole way through. We finally had a plan we all agreed on.”
testimonial.by: — Rachel, helping her mother sell in Glenelg, SA

data.heading: It is often the family who is ready

data.body:
A parent who is unsure about moving is not being difficult. They are being asked to leave a house they have made every decision of their adult life in. We are used to that conversation, and we are content to be the ones who say there is no rush.

If the move is a year away, ring us anyway. Knowing what it would actually involve — the order things happen in, what it costs, how long each part takes — is usually what makes it thinkable at all.
